name: Melilot
message: 「Traditional Japanese Music Day. Musical Instrument Day. Drinking Water Day. Cook Day. Yo-Yo Day」

name: Melilot
message: 「Frog Day. Hearing Aid Day. Horror Day. Warm and Fuzzy Day. Family Togetherness Day」

name: Melilot
message: 「Also, it should be Older Brother Day as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「Incidentally, Younger Brother Day is March 6. Younger Sister Day is September 6. Older Sister Day is December 6」

name: Melilot
message: 「Shall I also tell you the origins of each commemorative day?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Come to think of it, it was my birthday too. It had completely slipped my mind」
